title: Surreal Cosmic Encounter
description: A giant purple multi-eyed creature with a wide grin and flower-adorned head stands on a lavender hillside, extending its hand toward a small backpacking hiker on a path. Behind the creature is a radiant sunburst, while the background features a geometric mountain range, a colorful dome structure, and floating circular faces connected by swirling black smoke in the sky.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a giant smiling purple multi-eyed creature adorned with flowers standing on a hill covered in purple lavender flowers. The creature has a large circular head with many eyes and is reaching out toward a small human hiker with a red hat and backpack walking on a path. Behind the creature is a bright green and pink sunburst. In the background are black and white patterned triangular mountains, a colorful geodesic dome, and several floating purple circles containing faces connected by swirling black smoke against a white sky.
